title: Flesh Rippers

infobox.Crafting Materials: Fenris hair x3, Fenris claw x3, Silver x3

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Flesh Rippers are a weapon crafted from materials found in the Mountains. This is one of the 3 fist weapons in the game other than bare fists.
The primary attack is a 2-hit combo with 2x damage at the second hit. The secondary attack is a kick which does additional knockback and 6x staggering.
It deals 6x damage against unalerted enemies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The secondary attack is enough to stagger most creatures.
• Flesh Rippers like other fist weapons are the most durable of any weapon in the game by having durability value of 450 at max level.
